facts.text: W Miami is in the heart of Brickell, Miami's financial district.
facts.excerpt: a luxury hotel in the heart of Brickell—Miami’s dynamic financial district

facts.text: The hotel has views of the Miami River and the downtown skyline.
facts.excerpt: a pet-friendly retreat with sweeping views of the Miami River and downtown skyline

facts.text: The hotel offers easy access to South Beach, PortMiami and Kaseya Center.
facts.excerpt: W Miami offers effortless access to South Beach, PortMiami, Kaseya Center, and more

facts.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows, select private balconies and marble bathrooms with signature W amenities.
facts.excerpt: thoughtfully designed guest rooms and suites with floor-to-ceiling windows, select private balconies, marble bathrooms with signature W amenities

facts.text: Rooms have contemporary Hollywood Regency-inspired interiors and views of downtown Miami and Biscayne Bay.
facts.excerpt: Soaring floor-to-ceiling windows frame expansive views of vibrant downtown Miami and playful Biscayne Bay, while contemporary Hollywood Regency–inspired interiors

facts.text: The two-bedroom Penthouse Suite has contemporary interiors and views of Miami.
facts.excerpt: Our two-bedroom Penthouse Suite offers contemporary interiors set against vibrant views of Miami.

facts.text: TULUM Rooftop Bar & Restaurant serves local and global flavors with panoramic views of Biscayne Bay.
facts.excerpt: Savor local and global flavors at TULUM Rooftop Bar & Restaurant, complemented by panoramic views of Biscayne Bay.

facts.text: Guests have access to the Icon Brickell pool, spa and fitness center, which are operated independently from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Guests also enjoy access to the Icon Brickell pool, spa, and fitness center (operated independently from the hotel).

facts.text: Icon Brickell Spa offers massages, advanced facials, body treatments and nail services, with marine-based skincare.
facts.excerpt: Icon Brickell Spa offers a refined wellness experience with massages, advanced facials, body treatments, & nail services in a serene setting. Enjoy personalized care, marine-based skincare

facts.text: W Miami is part of the Icon Brickell complex, which includes residences and the restaurants Cipriani and Cantina La Viente.
facts.excerpt: W Miami is a part of the Icon Brickell complex, a luxury community in the heart of Brickell featuring the hotel, residences, and first-class restaurants, Cipriani and Cantina La Viente.

facts.text: W Miami is pet-friendly through its Pets Are Welcome (P.A.W.) program.
facts.excerpt: Our signature Pets Are Welcome™ (P.A.W.) program makes sure that furry friends enjoy their visit as much as you.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Valet parking is operated by Icon Brickell, not by W Miami.
facts.excerpt: Valet Parking available. Not operated or managed by W Miami.

facts.text: Rooms have the Signature W Hotel Bed.
facts.excerpt: the supreme comfort of our Signature W Hotel Bed
